native-convex-matched-numerical-axes-com.limitations: Exact affine-tetrahedron integrals use all raw native corner components with symmetric shear multiplicity. Same-mesh ports4/8/16 at quadrature10 and quadrature10/14 at ports8 isolate declared numerical axes while preserving every frozen input byte and all four model rows. Three spatial-level model-bias rows compare each actual native field to its separately audited prescribed finite-traction FEM reference on that same mesh; they are not cross-mesh field-convergence estimates. The prescribed Euclidean traction reference and native intrinsic profiles differ, so these differences are conditional model/distance/integration effects, not pure model error or resolved-contact truth. Destination disk identities are not inferred continuum islands. Original unweighted statistics, every raw maximum and unsupported pressure row remain. No physical convergence, application/contact-feedback or warmed-cost completion is asserted.
